provenance.base: synthetic ground-truth SCM for Workstream C (Finding 6b)
provenance.reason: Known-equation world so experiment 08 can audit declared actions through the true SCM rather than through an FCM the method also optimised against. The graph here is the exact data-generating process in src/data/load_synth_block.py; it is not inferred. It is the deliberate foil to synth_reach: identical features, bounds and cost model, differing only in the structural equations and the decisive age -> approved edge.

notes: SYNTHETIC: the data-generating structural equations are known in closed form (src/data/load_synth_block.py). income = 30 + 0.8*experience + 6*training + 0.15*age + eps; savings = 0.4*income + eps; approved = 1 iff 0.28*(age-44) + 0.05*(income-60) + 0.08*(savings-22) + eps >= 0.

age is immutable AND a direct parent of approved: for sufficiently young applicants no admissible income/savings move can offset the age penalty, so they have HONEST non-recourse. The sibling world synth_reach removes exactly the age -> approved edge, which is why recourse always exists there.
approved is a sink: no intervention may target a descendant of the prediction.
